t: The Files page shows every file shared with you or by you, and the chat it is in.
In this video, you will learn how to find a file, filter by type, download it, and open the chat it came from.
To open this page, click Files in the left menu.
The numbers show your files, the ones shared by you and with you, and the total size.
Each file shows its name, type and size, who shared it, the chat it is in, and when.
Use the tabs: All, Shared by you, or Shared with you.
Filter by type, for example only spreadsheets.
Or search by file name, person or group.
Press Download to save a file, or Chat to open the conversation it was shared in.
To send someone a file, press Share next to their name, or drop the file on their name.
Admins can press Free up space to delete old chat files for everyone. Choose how old, tick the box, and press Delete files.
Next in the Meetings menu: Meetings.
